"""Publish completed CPU audit preparation and current authoritative waiting state."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import psutil

REPO = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT = REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V178-phase-evidence-trial-v1'
V175 = ROOT.parent/'V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'
ADMISSION = ROOT.parent/'V178-phase-evidence-admission-v1'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=digest)


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def main():
    draft = read(ROOT/'draft-v1.json')
    for path, digest in draft['frozen_files'].items():
        assert ref(path)['sha256'] == digest
    for binding in draft['inputs']:
        assert ref(binding['path']) == binding
    assert len(draft['frozen_files']) == 713 and len(draft['inputs']) == 9
    seal = read(ROOT/'audit-source-v1.json')
    proof = read(ROOT/'audit-structural-proof-v1.json')
    entry = read(ROOT/'audit-frozen-entry-v1.json')
    assert proof['status'].startswith('pass-CPU-audit-structural') and not proof['CUDA_initialized']
    assert not proof['actual_V178_training_or_quality_audits_completed']
    assert all(proof[key] == 0 for key in ['actual_neural_forwards','actual_optimizer_updates','new_sensor_draws'])
    assert len(proof['rejected_deliberately_corrupted_adapted_records']) == 8
    assert sum(row['rows'] for row in proof['adapted_trace_checks'].values()) == 2000
    assert sum(row['FP32_loss_totals'] for row in proof['adapted_trace_checks'].values()) == 1800
    assert '34 passed' in proof['tests']['text'] and ref(proof['tests']['path']) == {k:proof['tests'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
    assert entry['status'].startswith('pass-actual-frozen-audit') and not entry['CUDA_initialized']
    assert entry['auditor'] == seal['auditor'] and entry['source_seal'] == ref(ROOT/'audit-source-v1.json')
    assert seal['actual_CPU_structural_proof'] == ref(ROOT/'audit-structural-proof-v1.json')
    helpers = []
    for binding in seal['helpers']:
        path = Path(binding['path'])
        assert ref(path) == binding
        current = REPO/path.relative_to(ROOT/'audit-work-v1')
        assert current.read_bytes() == path.read_bytes()
        helpers.append(dict(binding, text=path.read_text(), canonical=ref(current)))
    baseline = read(V175/'plan-v1.json')
    assert len(baseline['prior_neural_hashes']) == 96
    for name, digest in baseline['prior_neural_hashes'].items():
        assert ref(REPO/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256'] == digest
    neural = list((REPO/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'))
    assert len(neural) == 97
    for path in neural:
        assert path.read_bytes() == (Path(draft['work'])/'src/demosaic'/path.name).read_bytes()
    post = read(V175/'postprocess-inputs-v1.json')
    for binding in post['helpers']:
        assert ref(binding['path']) == binding
    assert len(post['helpers']) == 18
    observed = []
    for folder, launch_name, status_name in [
        (V175,'train-launch-v1.json','train-status-v1.json'),
        (V175,'completion-watch-launch-v1.json','completion-watch-status-v1.json'),
        (ADMISSION,'watch-launch-v1.json','watch-status-v1.json'),
        (ROOT,'controller-launch-v1.json','controller-status-v1.json')]:
        owner = read(folder/launch_name)['owner']
        process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        assert process.create_time() == owner['created'] and process.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
        assert not list(folder.glob('*failure-v1.json'))
        observed.append(dict(root=str(folder), owner=owner, live=True, status=read(folder/status_name)))
    for name in ['plan-v1.json','control-train.claim','evidence-train.claim','review.claim',
                 'control-train-launch-v1.json','evidence-train-launch-v1.json','review-launch-v1.json',
                 'scores-v1.json','training-audit-v1.json','quality-audit-v1.json']:
        assert not (ROOT/name).exists(), name
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat()
    public = REPO/'docs/results/v178-matched-trial-audit-preparation-v1.json'
    save(public, dict(status='pass-implemented-frozen-CPU-audit-preparation-no-actual-V178-result',
         recorded_local=stamp, draft=ref(ROOT/'draft-v1.json'), source_seal=seal,
         exact_helper_sources=helpers, structural_and_old_checkpoint_proof=proof,
         actual_frozen_entry_proof=entry,
         scientific_current_observations=observed,
         GiB_available=dict(RAM=psutil.virtual_memory().available/2**30,
                            local=shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free/2**30,
                            external=shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free/2**30),
         actual_V178_training_or_quality_audits_completed=False,
         new_GPU_calls=0, new_neural_forwards=0, new_optimizer_updates=0,
         scope='Independent audit implementation/CPU preparation only. Adapted old training and partially simulated metadata fixtures are explicit; no actual V178 training, prediction, quality or viewing result. Actual neural code, trial recipe, jobs and original receipts remain unchanged.',
         publisher=dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
    verification = REPO/'docs/results/v178-matched-trial-audit-publication-verification-v1.json'
    docs = [REPO/relative for relative in ['docs/phase-evidence-training.md','docs/index.md',
            'docs/experiments.md','diary/2026-11-07-21-08-26-phase-evidence-independent-audits.md']]
    count = 0
    for path in docs:
        for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
            if link.startswith(('http:','https:','mailto:','#')):
                continue
            target = (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
            assert target.exists() or target == verification, (path, link)
            count += 1
    save(verification, dict(status='pass-frozen-audit-preparation-sources-checks-live-owners-and-document-links',
         recorded_local=stamp, preparation=ref(public), documents=[ref(path) for path in docs],
         local_links_checked=count, trial_frozen_files_checked=713, trial_immutable_inputs_checked=9,
         additive_frozen_helpers_checked=2, actual_CPU_tests=34, adapted_old_trace_rows=2000,
         actual_old_FP32_totals_in_adapted_fixture=1800, deliberately_corrupted_old_records_rejected=8,
         saved_profile_geometry_cases=6, actual_old_checkpoint_loads_in_preparation=1,
         unchanged_current_neural_files=97, unchanged_original_V175_neural_files=96,
         unchanged_sealed_V175_helpers=18, verified_live_owners=observed,
         new_GPU_calls=0, new_trial_updates=0,
         actual_V178_training_or_quality_audits_completed=False,
         source=dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
         scope='Publication verification hashes/reads only. Process states are timestamp-specific. No neural/sensor/optimizer/checkpoint/CUDA work in this verifier; no actual V178 result or quality gain claimed.'))
    print('PASS publication/frozen713+2/input9/neural97/helper18/CPU34/links',count, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__': main()
